Whalley Abbey.today: it is now the Retreat and Conference House of the Diocese of Blackburn of the Church of England.
Whalley Abbey.survives: Only the foundations of the church remain.
Whalley Abbey.gateway: The North West Gateway is separately listed Grade I.
Whalley Abbey.abbot: Abbot Paslew was executed for high treason for his part in events connected with the Pilgrimage of Grace

Sawley Abbey.today: The ruins, which are now controlled by English Heritage, are open to the public.
Sawley Abbey.return: on 12 October, supported by the rebels, the monks returned to the empty abbey.
Sawley Abbey.poor: Despite being a relatively poor establishment, a scholarly tradition developed at the abbey.
Sawley Abbey.climate: The abbey struggled to survive with climactic conditions leading to crop failure
